VELOCITY TDIR
PLATFORM
See Velocity TDIR in Action
Born from cyber battlefield experience, the Velocity Threat Detection, Investigation and Response (TDIR) platform accelerates security operations with leading-edge, unified detection and response.
TDIR is the process of threat detection, investigation and response. TDIR products provide an operation platform to perform threat detection configuration, process alerting, carry out investigations and manage mitigating response processes for incidents.
TECHNOLOGY AGNOSTIC. INFINITELY FLEXIBLE
The Velocity TDIR platform collects, processes and queries vast amounts of data from a variety of sources in near real-time. Built by responders for responders, it is technology-agnostic, providing speed and efficiency in threat hunting, threat detection, forensic investigation, and response in any environment- cloud and on-premises, IT and OT.   Velocity can ingest up to 30 TB per day and run up to 100,000 queries daily.
Battle tested across thousands of incident response investigations; Velocity is also the backbone of Sygnia MDR.
Explore Sygnia MDR
COMPLETE VISIBILITY. BETTER THREAT DETECTION
Complete visibility is crucial for improving threat detection capability. However, each security tool set creates data in a silo.  Some tools combine data from a subset of tools. However, this is often limited to a subset of tools, and to the IT environment only.  Built to support IR investigations, the
Velocity platform is infinitely flexible. It features over
200 out-of-box integrations
, with the ability to create additional integrations for proprietary data sources.
Discover Our 200+ Integrations
VISIBILITY ACROSS IT AND OT
In an era of increasing digital interconnectedness, OT has emerged as a critical battlefield. Not constrained by environment or operating system, the Velocity platform provides visibility into OT environments, including legacy OT systems which most other IT detection tools cannot monitor.
Learn About Threat Detection Strategies for OT

Over 200 out-of-box integrations with IT and OT data sources.
3 forms of data integration: API based, Syslog transport, Manual log data update.

DATA ENRICHMENT
Raw data is enriched at ingestion using industry-leading enrichment tools and techniques, including proprietary MISP. AI is used to classify and normalize data. This means all data is enriched with cyber-context, no data is lost
Enriched data is stored in the Snowflake data lake for longevity and scalability
DATA QUERYING
Data can be queried in 2 ways: Manual and Automated.
Capable of running tens of thousands of queries per day.
Repository of proprietary search queries for ease of threat detection leveraging Sygnia’s extensive library of IOCs.
ALERT MANAGEMENT
Generates alerts based on queries and detection scenarios with summary of findings and detailed recommendations.
AI POWERED SEARCH
AI-assisted custom queries can be easily developed using Natural Language search terms.
PATHFINDER AGENT
Velocity uses Sygnia’s Pathfinder agent for data collection and response on servers and workstations including binary and memory data collection.

VELOCITY POWERS SYGNIA MDR
Battle tested across thousands of incident response investigations; Velocity is also the backbone of Sygnia MDR. Using Velocity for complete visibility across IT and OT environments, Sygnia MDR keeps organizations continuously secure 24/7/365.
Learn more about Sygnia MDR
Download the Solution Brief
THE POWER OF PATHFINDER
Download the Datasheet
Pathfinder is Sygnia’s proprietary, lightweight agent, built to enable, enhance and supplement existing binary data collection from servers and workstations as part of Velocity deployment.
SMALL FOOTPRINT
Designed to be non-intrusive. When idle, it uses 10MB of memory. Run with low priority, uses a single CPU core.
MINIMAL IMPACT ON USER TASKS
No OS hooks or monitors. Performs operations only when queried by Velocity.
Sends a heartbeat to Velocity to check in every 60 seconds, checking for new operations.
MINIMAL PRESENCE ON HOST EVENT LOGS
Pathfinder are done through OS APIs- no CMD/Shell commands are called.
MANAGES 3RD PARTY COLLECTORS
Enables easy installation and configuration of Microsoft Sysmon and Elastic Winlogbeat, Filebeat, and Auditbeat log collectors.
